subject: Evening walkthrough options for SOC 2 / pen test / DPA - GreenBank

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Andrea Soto <andrea.soto@greenbank.com>, security@greenbank.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security walkthrough availability (SOC 2 / pen test / DPA)

Hi Andrea —

Thanks for the quick intake form. We'd love to run a combined compliance walkthrough that covers SOC 2 scope, an outline of the upcoming pen test, and the DPA / data handling notes. To keep this efficient for your team, we typically run a 60–90 minute session where we:

- Review architecture and data flows (20–30 min)
- Controls and logging (20–30 min)
- Pen-test scope & timeline (10–15 min)
- DPA highlights and evidence handoff (10–15 min)

We know you have teams across timezones — below are two proposed slots. Please tell us which (if any) work and who from your side will join (infosec, app owners, procurement):

Option A — East / North America-friendly (evening):
• Tue Jul 22, 17:30–19:00 PDT (90 min)

Option B — Morning UTC window:
• Wed Jul 23, 08:00–09:30 UTC (90 min)

Attachments: SOC2-Overview.pdf, evidence-request.csv (high-level list). Also adding a short walkthrough-plan.docx for our internal presenters.

If neither slot works, share a couple of preferred blocks and we'll attempt to accommodate. Once we lock time I'll send a calendar invite and a shareable Drive folder with pre-reads.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0113

Subject: Re: Security walkthrough availability (SOC 2 / pen test / DPA)

Hi Ben —

Thanks — Option A (the evening PDT slot) should work for a few of our US-based engineers. I also have a UK-based security lead who prefers mornings BST. Can you confirm whether the session can be kept to 60 minutes if we skip the deeper pen-test details? We have two asks:

1) We need the pen-test scope summary (one slide) ahead of time for our procurement team.
2) Can you include a brief run-through of how Redwood handles evidence exports for SOC 2 (logs, retention, S3 access)?

Attendees from GreenBank: Andrea Soto (info-sec), Luis Mendez (app owner), procurement@greenbank.com.

If you can send the one-slide pen-test scope, we can confirm the final attendee list and then pick the best time.

Best,
